standard.summary: 学习率倍率每一步最多移动的比例（相对当前值）。0.1 = 每步最多 10%。
standard.effect: 默认 0.1。0 或负数启动时直接报错（0 会让倍率永远锁死在常态值，等于 Pilot 失效）。推荐 0.01–0.1。
standard.whenToUse: 想让干预更柔和就调小（如 0.05），更果断就调大。
standard.avoidWhen: 调太大（接近 1）等于没有限速，尖峰一步打穿。

standard_en.summary: How far the lr multiplier may move per step, relative to its current value. 0.1 = at most 10 percent per step.
standard_en.effect: Default 0.1. Zero or negative fails closed at startup (0 would pin the multiplier at its neutral value forever, disabling the pilot). Recommended 0.01-0.1.
standard_en.whenToUse: Lower for gentler modulation (e.g. 0.05), raise for more decisive moves.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Near 1.0 there is no rate limit at all.
